content: scikit-fda misc/infrastructure: Metrics — LpNorm, LpDistance, MahalanobisDistance, NormInducedMetric, PairwiseMetric, TransformationMetric; functions lp_norm, lp_distance, angular_distance, fisher_rao_distance, fisher_rao_amplitude_distance, fisher_rao_phase_distance. Scoring: explained_variance_score, mean_absolute_error, mean_absolute_percentage_error, mean_squared_error, mean_squared_log_error, r2_score. Operators: Identity, LinearDifferentialOperator (for penalties), SRSF. Regularization: L2Regularization. Covariance functions: Brownian, Covariance, Exponential, Gaussian, Linear, Polynomial, Matern, WhiteNoise. Datasets: fetch_aemet, fetch_gait, fetch_growth, fetch_handwriting, fetch_mco, fetch_medflies, fetch_nox, fetch_octane, fetch_phoneme, fetch_tecator, fetch_weather, fetch_bone_density, fetch_cran, fetch_ucr. Generation: make_gaussian, make_gaussian_process, make_sinusoidal_process, make_multimodal_samples, make_multimodal_landmarks, make_random_warping, make_sde_trajectories. Model selection: CV via sklearn integration.
